name: Brad Harris
biography: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Bradford Harris (born 16 July, 1933) is an American actor, stuntman, and executive producer. He appeared in a variety of roles in over 50 films, mostly in European productions. He is a member of the Stuntman's Hall of Fame.
